title: 1.011 - Validate ingested records against a schema
author: gardusi-gustavo-bot

legacy.author: gardusi-gustavo-bot
legacy.original_title: 1.0 - Validate ingested records against a schema
legacy.body:
## Summary

Validate records before load and fail closed when the shape does not match.

## Context

The ETL library has stage interfaces and retry rules, but no schema validation.
A malformed payload can reach a dashboard or a database.

## Expected outcome

- A schema per record family.
- Validation between transform and load.
- A typed error with the failing field.
- A strict/lenient mode.
- Fixtures for valid and invalid records.
- A versioned schema.

## Out of scope

- Building a schema registry service.
- Migrating stored data.
- Validating every external source at once.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every loader target has a schema.
- [ ] Invalid records fail before load.
- [ ] The error names the field and record.
- [ ] Strict mode is the default.
- [ ] Fixtures cover valid and invalid cases.
- [ ] A schema change is versioned.

## Plan

- [ ] Choose the schema format.
- [ ] Add validation to the pipeline.
- [ ] Add fixtures.
- [ ] Document strict/lenient behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] A missing required field fails.
- [ ] An unknown field follows the mode.
- [ ] A valid fixture loads.

## References

- ETL interfaces: #10
- Shared contracts: ops/templates#32
- Runtime errors: ops/templates#33
